==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
A barrier has been placed around Earth by outside forces. The planet is unsure of what to do. The leader of Earth travels into space to try to deal with the situation personally.

The forces that created the barrier, did so in an attempt to test humanity. The leader of Earth's bravery is recognized by the forces. He passes the test 

He evolves into a being with glowing magenta hair. He is now extremely powerful and can breathe in space. Using his newfound power, he breaks through the barrier with a powerful punch.
